newsitem.title: JAPAN: Towa Real Estate falls sharply.
newsitem.headline: Towa Real Estate falls sharply.

text.p: Shares of Towa Real Estate Development Co Ltd fell sharply on Friday due to market rumours that it is experiencing business difficulties, traders said.
Officials of the firm were not available to comments on the rumours due to a company holiday.
By midday on Friday the share was down 49 yen, or 37.40 percent, at 82 yen. The issue was the largest percentage loser on the first section of the bourse.
Turnover was 5.19 million shares, making it the second most actively traded issue on the TSE first section.

""Like Fujita Corp, there have been rumours that the company is suffering from business difficulties. After falling below 100 yen, the fall accelerated," said an official at a medium-sized Japanese securities house.
Construction company Fujita was down 16 yen at 89 yen at Friday midday. The issue was the third-largest percentage loser.
Turnover was 10.23 million shares, making the issue the most actively traded issue on the TSE first section.
